sections.①:
• 브랜드명: Bluesky (bsky.app)
  • 한 줄 정체성: AT Protocol 기반 분산형 소셜 — Twitter 출신팀이 만든 오픈 마이크로블로깅
  • 공식 디자인 철학: "Algorithms as a feature, not a prison" — 알고리즘 선택권을 사용자에게
  • 시그니처 요소 1개: 라이트 스카이 블루(#0085FF) + 흰 나비 로고 + 흰색 카드 베이스에 옅은 보더(#D9E2EB)의 청량한 톤. X의 검정 모노톤·Mastodon의 보라와 정반대의 깔끔한 라이트 톤
sections.②:
• 핵심 키워드 3개: 청량, 개방, 분산
  • 무드 설명: 흰 배경 + 옅은 회청색 보더. 채도 높은 강조는 액션 버튼과 링크만. 다크 모드에서는 짙은 네이비(#161E27).
  • 비주얼 스타일: 모던 미니멀
  • 밀도(Density): Comfortable
  • 모서리 성향: Round (12px 카드 / 9999px 액션)
  • 평면성: Flat — 보더 의존, 그림자 거의 없음

:root {
  /* Primary - Bluesky Blue */

  --color-neutral-200:  #E2E8F0;

sections.⑨:
Button

.btn { font: 600 14px/1 Inter, Pretendard, sans-serif; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 10px 18px; border: 0; cursor: pointer; }
.btn-primary { background: var(--color-primary-500); color: var(--text-on-primary); }
.btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-primary-600); }
.btn-secondary { background: var(--bg-elevated); color: var(--text-primary); border: 1px solid var(--border-default); }
.btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--bg-subtle); }
.btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: var(--color-primary-500); }
.btn-follow { background: var(--color-primary-500); color: #fff; }
.btn-following { background: transparent; color: var(--text-primary); border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); }

Input

.field { background: var(--bg-subtle); border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 10px 16px; font: 500 14px/1.3 inherit; color: var(--text-primary); }
.field:focus { background: var(--bg-elevated); border-color: var(--color-primary-500); outline: 0; }
.compose { background: transparent; border: 0; font: 400 18px/1.4 inherit; resize: none; }
.compose::placeholder { color: var(--text-tertiary); }

Card (Post)

.post { padding: 12px 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-default); display: flex; gap: 10px; cursor: pointer; }
.post:hover { background: var(--bg-subtle); }
.post .avatar { width: 42px; height: 42px; border-radius: 9999px; flex: none; }
.post .head { font: 600 14px/1.3 inherit; color: var(--text-primary); }
.post .head .handle { font-weight: 400; color: var(--text-tertiary); margin-left: 6px; }
.post .text { font: 400 15px/1.5 inherit; color: var(--text-primary); margin-top: 3px; }
.post .actions { display: flex; gap: 28px; margin-top: 10px; color: var(--text-tertiary); font: 500 12px/1 inherit; }
.embed { margin-top: 10px; border: 1px solid var(--border-default); border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; }

Badge / Tag

.badge-feed { background: var(--color-info-bg); color: var(--color-info-fg); border-radius: 6px; padding: 2px 6px; font: 600 11px/1.3 inherit; }
.tag-pds { background: var(--bg-subtle); color: var(--text-secondary); border: 1px solid var(--border-default); border-radius: 9999px; padding: 2px 8px; font: 500 11px/1.4 inherit; }
.handle-pill { background: var(--bg-subtle); color: var(--text-secondary); border-radius: 9999px; padding: 1px 8px; font: 500 11px/1.4 inherit; }

Navigation (좌측 레일)

.nav { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; padding: 12px; }
.nav .item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; padding: 10px 14px; border-radius: 9999px; font: 500 17px/1 inherit; color: var(--text-primary); cursor: pointer; }
.nav .item:hover { background: var(--bg-subtle); }
.nav .item.active { font-weight: 700; color: var(--color-primary-500); }
.nav .post-btn { background: var(--color-primary-500); color: #fff; padding: 13px; border-radius: 9999px; font: 700 15px/1 inherit; text-align: center; border: 0; }
sections.⑪: 1. 진한 네이비 단색 사용 금지 — Sky Blue(#0085FF)의 청량함이 시그니처 2. 카드에 큰 그림자 사용 금지 — 1px 보더(#D9E2EB)로 구분 3. 나비 외 다른 마스코트/아이콘 강조 금지 — 단일 로고 4. 카드 모서리 0px(샤프) 금지 — 12px Round 유지 5. 알고리즘 피드 단일 강요 금지 — "Custom Feeds" 탭이 시그니처

<style>
  * { box-sizing: border-box; }
  body { margin: 0; font-family: Inter, Pretendard, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; color: var(--text-primary); background: var(--bg-subtle); letter-spacing: -0.01em; }
  .bsky-showcase { --sky-wash: #E5F2FF; --sky-glow: #DDF8FF; --sky-line: #B9DBFA; min-height: 100vh; background: var(--bg-subtle); }
  .bsky-shell { width: min(1120px, 100%); min-height: 100vh; margin: 0 auto; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 210px minmax(0, 1fr); background: var(--bg-base); border-inline: 1px solid var(--border-default); }
  .bsky-rail { padding: 24px 18px; border-right: 1px solid var(--border-default); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 24px; background: var(--bg-base); }
  .bsky-brand { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 0 10px; color: var(--color-primary-500); }
  .bsky-brand svg { width: 31px; height: 31px; display: block; }
  .bsky-brand strong { color: var(--text-primary); font-size: 19px; font-weight: 750; line-height: 1; }
  .bsky-nav { display: grid; gap: 5px; }
  .bsky-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 13px; border-radius: var(--radius-full); color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: 15px; font-weight: 570; line-height: 1; }
  .bsky-nav-item svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; }
  .bsky-nav-item.active { color: var(--color-primary-500); background: var(--color-primary-50); font-weight: 700; }
  .bsky-account { margin-top: auto; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; padding: 10px; border: 1px solid var(--border-default); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); }
  .bsky-avatar { width: 34px; height: 34px; flex: none; border-radius: var(--radius-full); background: radial-gradient(circle at 68% 28%, #DDF8FF 0 14%, transparent 15%), linear-gradient(145deg, #67D6FE, #006FE0); }
  .bsky-account strong, .bsky-account span { display: block; }
  .bsky-account strong { font-size: 12px; }
  .bsky-account span { margin-top: 2px; color: var(--text-tertiary); font-size: 10px; }
  .bsky-content { min-width: 0; padding: 26px; }
  .bsky-topline { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; margin-bottom: 18px; }
  .bsky-topline h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 21px; font-weight: 760; line-height: 1.2; }
  .bsky-topline .tag-pds { padding: 5px 10px; }
  .bsky-hero { position: relative; min-height: 286px; padding: 38px; overflow: hidden; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 250px; align-items: center; gap: 24px; border: 1px solid var(--sky-line); border-radius: var(--radius-xl); background: radial-gradient(circle at 88% 12%, var(--sky-glow) 0, transparent 36%), linear-gradient(135deg, var(--sky-wash), var(--bg-elevated)); }
  .bsky-hero-copy { position: relative; z-index: 1; max-width: 570px; }
  .bsky-eyebrow { color: var(--color-primary-700); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 760; line-height: 1.2; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; }
  .bsky-hero h1 { max-width: 560px; margin: 12px 0 13px; color: var(--text-primary); font-size: clamp(32px, 5vw, 52px); font-weight: 790; line-height: 1.05; letter-spacing: -.045em; }
  .bsky-hero p { max-width: 500px; margin: 0; color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: 15px; font-weight: 430; line-height: 1.65; }
  .bsky-actions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 9px; margin-top: 22px; }
  .bsky-actions .btn { min-height: 40px; padding-inline: 18px; }
  .bsky-mark { position: relative; width: 220px; aspect-ratio: 1; margin-inline: auto; display: grid; place-items: center; }
  .bsky-mark::before, .bsky-mark::after { content: ""; position: absolute; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid var(--sky-line); }
  .bsky-mark::before { inset: 12px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-elevated) 58%, transparent); }
  .bsky-mark::after { inset: 37px; background: var(--bg-elevated); box-shadow: 0 16px 44px rgba(0, 133, 255, .15); }
  .bsky-mark svg { position: relative; z-index: 1; width: 102px; height: 102px; color: var(--color-primary-500); filter: drop-shadow(0 12px 18px rgba(0, 133, 255, .2)); }
  .bsky-feature-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 14px; margin-top: 14px; }
  .feature-card { min-height: 190px; padding: 19px; border: 1px solid var(--border-default); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); background: var(--bg-elevated); }
  .feature-card > .badge-feed, .feature-card > .tag-pds { display: inline-block; margin-bottom: 15px; }
  .feature-card h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 720; line-height: 1.3; }
  .feature-card > p { margin: 7px 0 16px; min-height: 40px; color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 420; line-height: 1.55; }
  .bsky-feed-row { display: flex; gap: 7px; }
  .bsky-feed-chip { flex: 1; min-width: 0; padding: 9px; border: 1px solid var(--border-default); border-radius: var(--radius-md); background: var(--bg-subtle); }
  .bsky-feed-chip i { display: block; width: 20px; height: 20px; margin-bottom: 7px; border-radius: 6px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--color-primary-500), var(--color-secondary-500)); }
  .bsky-feed-chip b, .bsky-feed-chip small { display: block; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
  .bsky-feed-chip b { font-size: 10px; }
  .bsky-feed-chip small { margin-top: 3px; color: var(--text-tertiary); font-size: 9px; }
  .bsky-handle { padding: 11px; border: 1px solid var(--border-default); border-radius: var(--radius-md); background: var(--bg-subtle); }
  .bsky-handle div { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
  .bsky-handle b { font-size: 11px; }
  .bsky-handle small { display: block; margin-top: 5px; color: var(--text-tertiary); font-size: 9px; }
  .bsky-check { width: 17px; height: 17px; border-radius: 999px; display: grid; place-items: center; background: var(--color-primary-500); color: var(--text-on-primary); font-size: 10px; }
  .bsky-thread { display: grid; gap: 9px; }
  .bsky-post-mini { display: flex; gap: 8px; color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: 10px; line-height: 1.4; }
  .bsky-post-mini .bsky-avatar { width: 24px; height: 24px; }
  .bsky-post-mini:nth-child(2) { margin-left: 15px; padding-left: 12px; border-left: 2px solid var(--border-default); }
  @media (max-width: 800px) {
    .bsky-shell { grid-template-columns: 1fr; border: 0; }
    .bsky-rail { display: none; }
    .bsky-content { padding: 16px; }
    .bsky-hero { grid-template-columns: 1fr; padding: 28px; }
    .bsky-mark { display: none; }
    .bsky-feature-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  }
</style>
